name: cs-paper-writing
description: Writing skills for CS papers on parallel algorithms and data structures, built from a corpus of 119 peer-reviewed papers.

plugins.name: academic-writing
plugins.description: Review, polish, paraphrase, or suggest edits to academic prose using writing patterns extracted from a corpus of well-regarded CS papers. Six ordered revision passes, 59 structural patterns, and a mechanical linter, all calibrated against corpus-wide measurements.
